settings.heading: Clinically dosed. Rigorously tested.
settings.content: A gummy should be held to the same standard as anything else you put in your body. Every batch of CREO is dosed to the gram and tested before it ever reaches you.

settings.title: The full 5g clinical dose
settings.text: The exact daily amount of creatine monohydrate used in the research — in every four-gummy serving. No fairy dust, no half-scoops.

settings.title: Tested every batch
settings.text: An independent lab verifies purity and potency on every run — not just once.

settings.title: Vegan & clean
settings.text: Pectin-based, never gelatin. Gluten-free, 2g sugar, no artificial dyes.

settings.title: Made in the USA, cGMP facility
settings.text: Formulated and produced under strict manufacturing standards, in a cGMP-compliant facility.

settings.heading: Tested, then tested again.
settings.text: Every batch is sent to an independent, third-party lab before it ships. We confirm the full 5g clinical dose is present, that it's pure creatine monohydrate, and that it's clear of contaminants like heavy metals and microbial impurities. If a batch doesn't pass, it doesn't go out.

settings.heading: Build, daily.
settings.text: A full clinical dose, tested every batch, in a gummy you'll actually look forward to.
